question:
An AI can describe what it sees, but it can’t know the story behind it. You can. Write two captions for this picture: the one an AI would write, and the one only a human would know.

Steps:
1. Use the text tool to write a caption the way an AI would, using only what it can see in the picture.
2. Use the text tool to write a second caption with the backstory only a human could know. Make it funny, strange, or dramatic.
3. Record your voice naming one thing about the picture that no one could know just by looking.

rubric.description: No text is placed on the board, or the voice recording is missing or blank.
Student writes only one caption, OR the two captions are almost the same.
The first caption names at least 3 things visible in the picture AND the second caption includes a backstory, reason, or feeling that cannot be seen in the picture.
Meets all of the above AND the voice recording names one specific thing no one could know from the picture and says what words could be added to a prompt to tell the AI.

whiteboard_starter_image_alt_text: A cartoon penguin wearing sunglasses stands under an open red umbrella at a bus stop on a sunny day. A brown suitcase sits beside it, and a wrapped red gift sits on the bench. A label at the top says "Write two captions for this picture."
